messages:
Lena Park: Heads-up: we're planning a breaking change for partner-facing SDKs — rename `Authorization` header to `X-Redwood-Auth` to support multi-tenant signing and future token families. Proposal: soft-deprecation flow (warnings + shim) over 10 weeks. Marketplace & hardware partners need to be involved. Thoughts?

Diego Ruiz: Oof header rename impacts a bunch of SI appliances that only whitelist exact headers. Do we have inventory of on-prem appliances from HW partners? @Alicia, marketplace listings might show custom curl examples that need edits.

Alicia - Marketplace PM: We track example snippets for ~25 marketplace integrations. If we get an official timeline + sample migrations, we can push docs + a banner on the listing. Request: 6 weeks minimum notice before hard cut.

Samir Khanna: From SDK side we can implement: 1) accept old header; 2) emit deprecation warning via response header `X-Redwood-Warn: auth-header-deprecated`; 3) add opt-in strict mode env var for customers. Plan to release shim in v4.0.2. Migration helper script can update CI configs.

Priya Nair: For partners that are hardware appliances, we should offer a firmware compatibility shim (small proxy) they can deploy in-line. Partner success team can co-bundle with our engineer-run migration if needed.

Lena Park: Timeline idea: Week 0: announce + SDK shim release; Week 2-6: partner testing window (canaries + appliance proxy); Week 8: marketplace docs updated and vendor town hall; Week 10: hard cut. Marketplace requested 8 weeks public notice; can we reconcile?

Diego Ruiz: Engineering ask: need a rollout gate based on error-rate delta <= 0.5% across Dedicated and private fleets. Also need a health-check endpoint for partners to exercise post-change.

Samir Khanna: Health-check plan: add `/vitals/compat` that returns current accepted auth headers and a sample token test. We'll include curl examples. Example snippet for partners:
```
# legacy
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/generate
# new
curl -H "X-Redwood-Auth: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/generate
```
We'll ship tests and CI job to hit partner listings nightly.

Partner Eng Bot: Reminder: create vendor-impact spreadsheet in /shared/partners/compat-2026 and schedule town hall invites after vendor list is locked.

Alicia - Marketplace PM: I'll start updating listing templates. For hardware partners, I'll coordinate with channel leads to add a firmware proxy note. Town hall Thursday 11am PT works — I'll reserve room and send invites.

Priya Nair: Suggestion: offer a dual-run window where both headers are accepted but new examples are highlighted. Also offer an SLA credit for partners who adopt early (marketing incentive).

Lena Park: Good call. Action items: Samir -> open SDK shim PR + migration script by EOD Wed; Diego -> add rollout gating job and health-check endpoint ticket; Alicia -> draft marketplace banner + schedule town hall; Priya -> draft partner concierge package and incentive language. I'll publish the public announcement doc once drafts are ready.

Samir Khanna: will do PR + unit tests. ETA Wed.

Diego Ruiz: creating gating job ticket now.

Alicia - Marketplace PM: drafting banner + vendor invite list, will share draft for review tomorrow.

Priya Nair: will circulate concierge offer draft and sample contract language.

Lena Park: Follow-up sync Friday 9am PT. Tagging partner leads to ensure HW SI feeds are included. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
